run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 (Commonwealth AusTender) covered via web search snippets, yielding buyer-confirmed open opportunities. State portals (VIC, WA, QLD, SA, NSW), Tier 2 (Sydney Water, universities, health) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP) were queried at the search level. Direct portal fetches were NOT possible: the session's egress proxy blocked every outbound domain (all .gov.au, .com.au, aggregator and even wikipedia.org returned EGRESS_BLOCKED), so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened this run. All captured tenders are therefore corroborated from search-result snippets plus, where available, the buyer's own news/opportunity page text, not from a live fetch of the notice. New-source discovery surfaced the Commonwealth's new AusTender Supplier Portal (Central Procurement Systems), which becomes available to all businesses from 1 July 2026.
gaps: WebFetch fully blocked this run: the egress proxy returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every destination tried, including www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.health.qld.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, estimateone.com, tenders.net and en.wikipedia.org. No tender detail page or attachment could be read; all detail is from search snippets, so deliverables/requirements/documents fields are largely null.

Tier 1 state portals (VIC Buying for Victoria, Tenders WA, QTenders, Tenders SA, NSW buy.nsw) could only be searched, not swept; no new state-level opportunities were confirmed with a buyer-verified closing date this run - deferred to a future run when portal access is available.

SAP Ariba Discovery and BHP 'Find opportunities' were queried but expose no publicly-visible open RFx without a supplier login; both remain registration-gated (recorded as portals only, no tenders invented).

Health (NSW Local Health Districts) and university opportunities appeared only via paid aggregators (australiantenders.com.au, tenderhub.com.au) with no buyer-originated confirmation reachable, so none were captured as tenders.
'Tenders SA' searches are polluted by South-African (SARS/DIRCO) results; South Australian coverage this run is weak and deferred.
recommended_seed_additions: AusTender Supplier Portal / Central Procurement Systems (services-admin.tenders.gov.au and the supplier-portal help pages) - Commonwealth Dept of Finance, phased rollout Oct 2025-Jun 2026, all businesses from 1 Jul 2026.

Department of Industry, Science and Resources - business opportunities / news feed (industry.gov.au) as a buyer-originated notice channel that mirrors its AusTender ATMs (e.g. Northern Endeavour decommissioning).

tenders.title: Northern Endeavour Decommissioning Program Phase 3A - Request for Tender
tenders.buyer: Department of Industry, Science and Resources
tenders.category: Oil and gas decommissioning / marine services
tenders.description: The Department of Industry, Science and Resources seeks a lead contractor to deliver Phase 3A of the Northern Endeavour Decommissioning Program - the recovery, transport and offloading of subsea infrastructure from the Laminaria and Corallina oil fields to a nominated Australian port.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Recovery of subsea infrastructure from the decommissioned Laminaria and Corallina oil fields (Timor Sea), transport of the recovered infrastructure, and offloading at a nominated Australian port. The Commonwealth wants the offshore subsea assets safely removed and brought to shore as part of the staged decommissioning of the former Northern Endeavour FPSO facilities.
key_deliverables: Recovery of subsea infrastructure from the Laminaria and Corallina fields
Transport of recovered infrastructure to shore
Offloading at a nominated Australian port
tenders.eligibility: Open (public approach to market via AusTender)
tenders.delivery_location: Laminaria and Corallina oil fields (Timor Sea) to a nominated Australian port
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM listing (ATM_2026_3048) corroborated by the buyer's own announcement at industry.gov.au/news/northern-endeavour-decommissioning-program-phase-3a-request-tender; read from search snippets only (detail page egress-blocked).
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via web search of AusTender current ATMs; buyer-originated Commonwealth RFT published by the Department of Industry, Science and Resources and mirrored on the department's own news page.
tenders.notes: Publish date, closing date/time and scope taken from search snippets and the buyer's news release; full RFT documents, value, evaluation criteria and contact were not captured because the AusTender detail page could not be fetched (egress-blocked).

tenders.title: Long Term Commonwealth Lease - Brunswick Heads, NSW
tenders.category: Lease and rental of property or building
tenders.description: Services Australia is seeking a long-term Commonwealth lease of commercial/retail premises in the Brunswick Heads area of northern NSW to accommodate a service delivery presence.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of leased commercial/retail accommodation on a long-term Commonwealth lease within Brunswick Heads and surrounding precincts, with good access to public transport and car parking, suitable for a Services Australia service-delivery site.
key_deliverables: Long-term lease of suitable commercial/retail premises
Location within Brunswick Heads, New Brighton, Ocean Shores, South Golden Beach or Mullumbimby precincts
Good access to public transport and car parking
tenders.eligibility: Open to property owners/agents able to offer conforming premises in the nominated precincts
tenders.contract_term: Long-term lease (term not published in snippet)
tenders.submission_method: Proposals to the Commonwealth's property agent (Jones Lang LaSalle) by email
tenders.delivery_location: Brunswick Heads / New Brighton / Ocean Shores / South Golden Beach / Mullumbimby, NSW 2483
tenders.contact_name: Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL) - Commonwealth property agent
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM listing 'RFP BRUNSWICK HEADS' read from search snippet; location, closing time and JLL contact email taken from the snippet (detail page egress-blocked).
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via web search of AusTender current ATMs; buyer-originated Commonwealth property RFP issued by Services Australia and managed by its agent JLL.
tenders.notes: Publish date, lease term, floor area and value not captured - the AusTender detail page and any RFP documents could not be fetched (egress-blocked). Contact email is the JLL lodgement address quoted in the search snippet.

tenders.title: Seaboats and Watercraft Panel - Request for Tender
tenders.description: The Department of Defence is establishing a panel of experienced Australian suppliers able to design, integrate, manufacture and support seaboats and watercraft capabilities for Defence and other Commonwealth agencies, reducing procurement lead times through a consistent contracting framework.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Establishment of a standing panel to supply seaboats and watercraft - covering design, integration, manufacture and through-life support - plus immediate procurement opportunities delivered through identified Tasking Statements under ASDEFCON contracting templates.
key_deliverables: Panel establishment for seaboat/watercraft design, integration, manufacture and support
Immediate procurement opportunities via identified Tasking Statements
Consistent ASDEFCON-based contracting framework for future acquisitions
tenders.scope_of_work: The panel is expected to cover the majority of Defence's requirements for seaboats and watercraft. The RFT was developed using ASDEFCON contracting templates and includes both panel establishment requirements and immediate procurement opportunities through identified Tasking Statements.
tenders.eligibility: Experienced Australian suppliers of watercraft capability
tenders.briefing: Industry briefing held 1:00 PM 25 August 2026, Sydney CBD (max two representatives per prospective tenderer; nominations to the Contact Officer by 5:00 PM AEST 20 August 2026).
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM listing (PBSS/RFT/92347/1) read from search snippet; industry-briefing details from the snippet (detail page egress-blocked).
tenders.reasoning: Re-confirmed as still open during this run's AusTender sweep; buyer-originated Defence RFT. Previously seen in an earlier run (kept as active_in_latest), not a new discovery.
tenders.notes: Closing date/time not captured this run; industry briefing (25 Aug 2026) has passed. Full RFT documents and value not captured because the AusTender detail page could not be fetched (egress-blocked). Headline/active-status entry pending full detail.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Web search for new Australian government procurement platforms surfaced Department of Finance news that the first tranche of the new AusTender Supplier Portal has launched (Oct 2025), with ~10,000 suppliers onboarding across 515 active panels through to June 2026 and availability to all businesses from 1 July 2026. Does not replace AusTender (tenders still published there) but adds a supplier-discovery layer.
discovered_sources.notes: Buyer-originated (Dept of Finance). Lets suppliers register business attributes (Indigenous, SME, women-owned, ANZ) so agencies can discover them for panel/sourcing events. Portal detail could not be fetched this run (egress-blocked); recorded from Finance/help.tenders.gov.au announcements.
